title: relayer-http client stats
description: How clients use the relayer, counted from the summary lines over the selected range: volume per flow, users, contracts, repeats of one request and what made clients retry (monitoring/design.md, Usage and Dashboards).

list.name: flow
list.label: Flow (repeats)
list.description: Filters the Repeats and retries row only; the other panels name their flow.

options.content: OperatorLookupClient stats

panels.title: Requests by flow
panels.description: Requests answered in the range, by flow; `none` is a request answered before its flow was known.

targets.expr: sum by (fields_flow) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Succeeded: public decrypt
panels.description: Share of the public decrypt requests in the range that succeeded (2xx), every outcome counted.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "public_decrypt" | fields_outcome = "succeeded" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "public_decrypt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Succeeded: user decrypt
panels.description: Share of the user decrypt requests in the range that succeeded (2xx), every outcome counted.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" | fields_outcome = "succeeded" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Distinct users
panels.description: Distinct user addresses of the user decrypt requests in the range.

targets.expr: count(sum by (fields_user_address) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" | fields_user_address != "none" [$__range])))

panels.title: Distinct contract sets
panels.description: Distinct values of contract_addresses of the user decrypt requests in the range: one comma-separated set per request, so a request on two contracts counts as their pair.

targets.expr: count(sum by (fields_contract_addresses) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" | fields_contract_addresses != "none" [$__range])))

panels.title: Requests sent more than once
panels.description: decryption_ids seen in more than one request in the range, every flow: the same request content sent again (client retries, or several clients).

targets.expr: count(sum by (fields_decryption_id) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_decryption_id != "none" [$__range])) > 1)

panels.title: Top contracts
panels.description: The 20 contract sets with the most user decrypt requests in the range. Click one to list its requests in the lookup.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (contract_addresses) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" | fields_contract_addresses != "none" | label_format contract_addresses=fields_contract_addresses [$__range])))

panels.title: Top users
panels.description: The 20 user addresses with the most user decrypt requests in the range. Click one to list its requests in the lookup.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (user_address) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" | fields_user_address != "none" | label_format user_address=fields_user_address [$__range])))

panels.title: Requests of the top contracts
panels.description: User decrypt requests per interval of the 5 busiest contract sets at each point.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (contract_addresses) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow = "user_decrypt" | fields_contract_addresses != "none" | label_format contract_addresses=fields_contract_addresses [$__interval])))

panels.title: Requests sent more than once, by outcome
panels.description: Each decryption_id seen in more than one request in the range, with how many of its tries ended in each outcome; follows the Flow (repeats) box. Click one to see every try in the lookup.

targets.expr: sum by (decryption_id, outcome) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow =~ "$flow" | fields_decryption_id != "none" | label_format decryption_id=fields_decryption_id, outcome=fields_outcome [$__range])) and on (decryption_id) (sum by (decryption_id) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow =~ "$flow" | fields_decryption_id != "none" | label_format decryption_id=fields_decryption_id [$__range])) > 1)

panels.title: Codes of requests sent more than once
panels.description: The answer codes of every try of a decryption_id seen more than once, following the Flow (repeats) box: what made clients send the request again (a transient code), and how the repeats ended.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (sum by (decryption_id, code) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow =~ "$flow" | fields_decryption_id != "none" | label_format decryption_id=fields_decryption_id, code=fields_code [$__range])) and on (decryption_id) (sum by (decryption_id) (count_over_time({app="$app", instance=~"$instance"} |= "request completed" | json | fields_message = "request completed" | fields_flow =~ "$flow" | fields_decryption_id != "none" | label_format decryption_id=fields_decryption_id [$__range])) > 1))
